features.title: Pilot features
features.intro: Off by default. Only {{orgThe}} in the pilot sees them. Every change asks for a reason and is kept in the history.
features.photosLegalHolds: {{orgThisCap}} has photos under a legal retention obligation. Turning the module off keeps them, it does not delete them, and the administration {{orgOf}} can keep reviewing or releasing them.
features.finanzasOffWithBilling: Premium Billing will become read-only: the history is kept, with no new invoices.
features.toastDeactivatedHolds: Feature turned off. Photos under legal retention are kept and the administration {{orgOf}} can keep reviewing them.
features.errorRequiresFinanzas: Billing requires Finance to be on.
features.errorNotForModality: This feature does not exist for this type of organization.
features.errorSave: The change could not be saved.

SMARTMATCH.title: SmartMatch
SMARTMATCH.detail: Opportunities, applications and shifts from SmartMatch.

EN_CAMINO.title: On the way and “I've arrived”
EN_CAMINO.detail: Departure notice, declared delays and arrival with location.

FINANZAS.title: Finance
FINANZAS.detail: Services and rates {{orgOf}}. ETNARA Central only turns it on or off: it sees no amounts or financial data.

FACTURACION.title: Premium Billing
FACTURACION.detail: Invoices {{orgOf}} to its clients. Requires Finance. ETNARA Central only turns it on or off and designates the permissions manager: it sees no invoices, rates or amounts.

SHIFT_REPORTS.title: Shift report
SHIFT_REPORTS.detail: A report for each visit with its real records, reviewed and approved by {{orgThe}}. ETNARA Central only turns it on or off: it does not see report content.

PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.title: Phone notifications
PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.detail: Push notices {{orgOf}} to people who turn them on in their phone (general text, no names or health data). ETNARA Central only turns it on or off: it sees neither the notices nor the phones.

CONTRACTS.title: Contracts
CONTRACTS.detail: Contract with ETNARA, electronic signature by the designated representative and terms by role, only in {{orgThis}}. Also needs the contracts module on in the server; it does not publish documents or skip legal approval. Turning it off prevents new acceptances and does not delete contracts or records.

ACTIVITY_PHOTOS.title: Activity photos
ACTIVITY_PHOTOS.detail: Caregivers' photos, reviewed by {{orgThe}} before the family sees them, with consent. ETNARA Central only turns it on or off: it sees neither the photos nor the consents.

HOGAR_CALENDARIO.title: Care home · Calendar
HOGAR_CALENDARIO.detail: Administrative calendar of the care home. No clinical features.

HOGAR_ASIGNACIONES.title: Care home · Resident assignment
HOGAR_ASIGNACIONES.detail: Administrative assignment of residents to the care home staff.

HOGAR_PONCHES.title: Care home · Time clock
HOGAR_PONCHES.detail: Staff clock-in and clock-out with the facility's weekly code.

DEMO_ENVIRONMENT.title: Demo environment
DEMO_ENVIRONMENT.detail: Shows the “Demo environment — Fictitious data” banner across the care home portal. Only for demo care homes.
